values_quote: Safety is our No. 1 priority at Columbia
values_label: VERIFIED (attributed to Bob Heidorn, President and COO; also in heraldstaronline.com 2025-10-29; second quote from Stephanie Merkle, Community Engagement Manager: "This grant has a simple goal: to bolster safety training and education in our state")
budget_evidence: Inaugural Public Safety Grant funded by NiSource Charitable Foundation: 13 Ohio orgs (fire depts, police leadership, EMT certification, Westlake Town Criers National Night Out run/walk). Supporting only: Introduce a Girl to STEAM (Feb 2026, 300+ girls, 5 states incl Ohio) and Charity Ticket Program at Nationwide Children's Hospital Championship golf (both from search snippets, not opened).
budget_size: $500-$5,000 per grant (VERIFIED); program total not published
budget_label: VERIFIED for grants (foundation grants = supporting only); STEAM/golf UNVERIFIED
sponsorship_pattern: Small foundation grants to fire/police/EMT groups, employee-committee selection, statewide 61-county service area. Third-party listing (unopened, may be outdated) says next cycle opens Sept 1 2026. No agency or experiential-tour evidence found. Not a presenting-sponsor pattern.
retrenchment_note: No layoffs found for Columbia/NiSource. Community giving continued (Feb 2026 STEAM, 2026 Environmental Action Grant per search snippet, UNVERIFIED). Company framing is safety/reliability and rate-case defense ('customers will not receive safe and reliable service unless Columbia has' enough funding, PUCO attorney, WOSU 2025-10-29).
decision_roles: President/COO; Community Engagement Manager; NiSource Charitable Foundation; employee selection committee. Field/experiential, multicultural and sponsorship roles not found.
named_people_published: Bob Heidorn (President and COO) and Stephanie Merkle (Community Engagement Manager) - https://crawfordcountynow.com/local/13-organizations-to-benefit-from-columbia-gas-of-ohios-public-safety-grant/
conflicts: Other gas utilities (Enbridge Gas Ohio, formerly Dominion East Ohio; NIPSCO/other NiSource units are same parent). Safety-hood theme is not in conflict. Enbridge Gas Ohio: site opened (enbridgegas.com/ohio) shows only emergency/811 safety messaging and a rate case; Dominion transition page not opened (search snippet said grant process 'will be shared soon'); Enbridge 2025 Safe Community First Responder Program $1.5M to 217 US orgs is UNVERIFIED snippet. Enbridge is not clearly better; Dominion historically gave $110K Community Impact Awards (old, UNVERIFIED).
best_event_format: Fire department or workplace screening framed as safety-education grant tie-in; apply via grant-sized ask ($5K) rather than presenting sponsor. Partner with Cleveland-area fire dept applicant.
risks: Ohio Supreme Court heard appeal of $68.1M rate case/fixed charge rise to ~$58 (VERIFIED, WOSU 2025-10-29); search says court later upheld it (UNVERIFIED snippet, courtnewsohio.gov 2026). PUCO pipeline safety violation citations and past explosion settlements (older, snippets). Consumer cost sensitivity.
ohio_presence: Ohio's largest gas utility, 61-county service area (VERIFIED, heraldstaronline); Columbus HQ. Cleveland area is Dominion/Enbridge territory, not Columbia's core; Columbia does serve parts of NE Ohio (e.g., Lorain, Westlake area per grant recipient North Ridgeville/Westlake).
notes_unverified: Pitch-fit moderate: A strong, B only small foundation grants. Charity ticket, STEAM, Environmental grant, Enbridge $1.5M, Dominion awards are unopened search snippets. Columbia site /community/columbia-cares returned 404. businesswire STEAM release 403.

Mark Rober, Boston-born Jamad Fiin, 30+ community partners worldwide. LEGO Education promotes Ohio STEM grants (Central Ohio STEM Innovation Grant, application due June 25 2025, programs start by June 2026) but funder not stated on page (appears Battelle-administered, INFERRED).
budget_label: VERIFIED for event existence; size unknown
sponsorship_pattern: Owned experiential (Boston), store events, Playmaker creators, partners (Serpentine, TED Play@TED NYC May 14 2026 per snippet), LEGO Community Fund US / ChangeX Community Play Fund (UNVERIFIED snippets, museums/children 0-14). Only 4 flagship cities globally; US = Boston only. Local World Play Day events are fan-group run (Pittsburgh, UNVERIFIED), not LEGO paid.
retrenchment_note: LEGO Education announced it will not renew FIRST partnership; 2026-27 is last FIRST LEGO League season, successor in 2027-28 'fully controlled and designed by LEGO' (VERIFIED, StoneWars 2026-03-19, secondary). Signals program restructuring, not necessarily cuts. No LEGO layoffs found.
decision_roles: SVP Global Brand Development; LEGO Group US community/brand; LEGO Foundation (Denmark); LEGO Education; LEGO Community Fund US; store/retail events. Field/sponsorship roles not found.
conflicts: Fits maker/inventor theme; Mark Rober (former NASA engineer) is a LEGO Playmaker, aligning with inventor story. Competitors (Mattel, Hasbro) not tied. FIRST relationship ending.
best_event_format: Library or museum screening with a build-challenge talkback ('invent a safety device') around June 11 World Play Day; request educator toolkit or store make-and-take tie-in. Ask is more kit/in-kind than cash.
risks: Tariffs paused Pick-a-Brick custom parts in US/Canada (UNVERIFIED snippet, 2025); Musk X lawsuit named LEGO among advertisers (2025, UNVERIFIED); FIRST split (VERIFIED secondary).
ohio_presence: Legoland Discovery Center Columbus (Merlin-run, opened 2018) with Ohio Miniland; LEGO stores in Westlake and Beachwood (Axios 2026-03-20 snippet, page 403, UNVERIFIED). No LEGO Group corporate office found in Ohio.
notes_unverified: Passes only loosely: budget is global/Boston, not Ohio local. Axios page 403. Legoland, stores, TED, Community Fund items from snippets. Ohio STEM grant pages are LEGO Education marketing, not LEGO-funded.
